messages.subject: Adding regression line using ggpubr package
parts:
The function stat reg line equation allows to get the equation and r square value but it messes up the existing legend. A letter “a” appears over the legend symbols.

I used the following code:
b+stat_regline_equation(aes(label=paste(..eq.label..,..rr.label..,sep=“~~~~”)))

b contained the graph from ggplot

Also, can i customise how the equation appears?

Instead of y=c+mx ; I would like y=mx+c

Any help is appreciated.

Thanks,
